acceptance: Root cause for each of the four errors identified against the documented internal ingestion workflow (cite the doc or tool).

A fresh local bundle produced by the documented command passes validate_submission.py --require-manifest (or the documented internal-ingestion validator) with zero errors, shown on SQLite ClickBench SF1 and one DuckDB bundle.
Regression tests cover redaction of absolute paths and tuning diagnostics if code changed; make pr-preflight passes; PR merged.
description:
Found while rerunning SQLite ClickBench SF1 (bundle clickbench_sf1_sqlite_sql_20261025_093703_01cd0210 in ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results): validate_submission.py --require-manifest reports four errors: platform.tuning.applied carries unanonymized harness_default PRAGMA statements; platform.config.database_path and platform.raw_config.database_path hold absolute local paths; the sidecar manifest is missing; `benchbox submit` refuses without a pseudonym salt and, with a throwaway salt, still refuses over the tuning diagnostics. Every planned local rerun (published-results-sqlglot-translation-rerun, tpcds-obt-rerun-defective-sf1-bundles-20261017, corpus-tpch-shallow-cohort-replacements-20261018) will hit this before ingestion.
DECISION GATES: (G1) if the fix needs a change to what the published bundle schema records (dropping or redacting fields), choose the option that matches how existing internal corpus bundles were produced and ingested (precedent in results-data and the ingestion tooling); stop and ask if no precedent exists. (G2) salt handling: use the documented internal-ingestion path; never commit a salt.
GUARDRAILS: never weaken validate_submission checks to pass; fix the producer or use the documented internal ingestion path. No ingestion or publication without owner approval. Existing published bundles untouched.
